cases.summary: [Bug]: Auto Redact no longer has an upload button
cases.description:
### Installation Method

Docker

### The Problem

I recently installed the latest docker image 0.35.1 and it works perfectly on all but one option, the Auto Redact option, my hope is that this is a simple fix but i notcied that there is no longer an upload button on auto redact.
![IMG_20241204_133805](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4206ccd4-43a9-4907-b5c0-a3e0b8b5b0fd)

### Version of Stirling-PDF

### Last Working Version of Stirling-PDF

0.35.0

### Page Where the Problem Occurred

http://wfs-pdf/auto-redact

### Docker Configuration

_No response_

### Relevant Log Output

_No response_

```txt
We have a local dns that converts the wfs-pdf to local ip of host
```

### No Duplicate of the Issue

- [X] I have verified that there are no existing issues raised related to my problem.

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix missing upload button

# Description

The code snippet `input[type=file]{ display: none;}` was unintentionally hiding the upload button everywhere, to fix this, it was changed to only target input within `.input-container`.

Closes #2390
